question: Which January appointments were scheduled but did not result in patient therapy? Distinguish a no-show, a clinic cancellation, and a patient cancellation, and explain why an unsigned draft or charge is insufficient evidence of delivery.
Trace the documented work-message task from January 14 through January 30. On which dates was an action merely proposed or drafted, and when does the record first establish that Rowan sent a message?

Did the January 16 portal questionnaire review or the January 26 imported measurement summary document an additional treatment visit or a new questionnaire completion? Identify the distinct questionnaire completions and explain the source identities.

What do the records establish about suicidal thoughts at specific assessments, and can they establish that suicidal thoughts were absent throughout every day of the episode? State the evidence limits.

Which completed contacts in the review period were not patient psychotherapy even though a professional provided a service? Distinguish medication management, partner-only collateral contact, and professional care coordination.
